title: Float a sample-loaded microtube rack in a benchtop ultrasonic bath, close its lid and press ON
instruction: Float the sample-loaded microtube rack level in the ultrasonic water bath, close the hinged cover flush, press ON to start sonication, and let go without wetting the grippers.
context: Biological, chemical and clinical laboratory technicians (over 559,000 US workers across BLS SOC 19-4021, 19-4031, 19-1021 and 29-2010) routinely sonicate capped 1.5 mL microcentrifuge sample tubes in compact benchtop ultrasonic water baths to degas reagents, disperse pellets and lyse cells. Standard wet-lab operating procedure uses commercial closed-cell foam floating racks (such as the Heathrow Scientific HS29041B water-bath and sonicator floating microtube rack) so the conical tube bottoms hang immersed in the ultrasonic bath while snap-caps and operator or robot fingers stay above the waterline, followed by closing the bath's hinged acoustic lid to contain cavitation mist and pressing ON.
setup: Positions are in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases (x forward, y to the robot's left; heights above the table top z = 0). Bench mat: fixed charcoal non-slip silicone, 22.0 x 22.0 x 0.4 cm, centred at (25.0, -5.5). Stow mat: fixed olive-slate silicone, 15.0 x 15.0 x 0.4 cm, centred at (25.0, +17.0). Staging cradle: 3D-printed open-well PETG stand (fabricate.py: staging_cradle.stl, 7.4 x 10.2 x 2.6 cm with a 4.5 x 7.5 x 2.0 cm inner clearance well and a perimeter ledge at +2.3 cm above the stow mat), fixed on the stow mat at (25.0, +17.0). Ultrasonic bath: a Magnasonic CD2800 600 mL benchtop ultrasonic cleaner ($44.99, ASIN B007Q2661E; 14.0 x 20.0 x 8.4 cm pearl-white ABS body with a 9.6 x 15.6 x 5.2 cm brushed 304 stainless tank from floor +3.2 cm to rim +8.4 cm above the bench mat), fixed on the bench mat at (25.0, -5.5). Tank is filled with 480 mL tap water to its engraved MAX line (3.8 cm water depth, water surface at +7.0 cm above the bench mat, 1.4 cm below the +8.4 cm tank rim, verified before each trial with the 14.0 mm step of fabricate.py: freeboard_gauge.stl). Its rear-hinged smoked-blue domed polycarbonate cover (hinge along y at x_rel +5.2 cm, z_rel +8.5 cm; 1.6 cm arched interior crown; front grip tab) starts propped open at 102 deg from closed (12 deg past vertical against its rear gravity stop). Its front oval control apron (-x face at x_rel -9.0 cm, z_rel +5.9 cm) carries the teal ON push-button (y_rel -2.6 cm) and grey OFF push-button (y_rel +2.6 cm), each fitted with a 1.4 x 2.2 x 0.6 cm self-adhesive PETG actuator cap (fabricate.py: button_actuator_cap.stl, 4.0 mm vertical travel, 900 N/m spring, clicks at 2.5 mm / 2.25 N), flanking a red cycle-status LED at y_rel 0.0 cm (initially off). Floating sample rack: a Heathrow Scientific HS29041B 8-well rectangular closed-cell EVA foam floating rack ($14.50; 5.4 x 8.2 x 2.0 cm, 6.0 g, 2 x 4 bored 11.0 mm wells) loaded with eight snapped-shut Eppendorf 0030120086 Safe-Lock 1.5 mL polypropylene tubes each holding 1.00 mL tap water (8 x 2.0 g = 16.0 g; total loaded mass 22.0 g), staged level on the cradle ledge at (25.0, +17.0) with foam centre +3.34 cm above the stow mat and its eight 1.9 cm conical tube tips hanging 0.40 cm clear of the cradle floor. For real-robot water protection, both shared parallel gripper pads are sheathed in disposable powder-free nitrile finger cots with a high-contrast 4 mm white depth-reference band 4 mm above each pad tip. Both arms start at READY.
scoring: The trial's score is evaluated at its final step (SCORE_OVER = end; zero permanent positive latches). Pressing ON on a water-filled bath without the rack is not a dry-run fault (it starts the 180 s transducer timer and lights the red LED, which OFF cancels), but earns 0 until the rack is floating inside. Permanent 0.0 failure latches: (a) rack_flooded: rack tilts > 18.0 deg from vertical at any step or drops below +1.5 cm above the mat; (b) gripper_wet: any point of either gripper's finger pads enters the open tank opening (|x - 25.0| < 5.2 cm, |y + 5.5| < 8.2 cm while cover > 15 deg open) below water + 0.4 cm (+7.4 cm above the bench mat). Otherwise, let floating_level hold when the rack sits inside the bath within |x - 25.0| <= 2.0 cm, |y + 5.5| <= 3.6 cm, |z_centre - (+7.61 cm above mat)| <= 0.6 cm (Archimedes equilibrium of the 22.0 g rack: 8 submerged 1.9 cm tube cones displace 7.30 mL and the 38.1 cm^2 net foam underside drafts 3.86 mm, leaving 16.1 mm of dry foam freeboard above the +7.0 cm waterline and 15.1 mm under the tube tips above the +3.2 cm tank floor) with tilt <= 6.0 deg. End-step tiers: 1.00 when floating_level holds, the domed cover is closed within <= 6.0 deg of its rim stop, the ultrasonic cycle is actively ON (red LED lit, buttons released < 1.0 mm), every finger pad of both arms is >= 3.0 cm clear of bath and rack, and the rack speed stays < 1.0 cm/s continuously over the final 1.0 s (20 steps at 20 Hz); 0.75 when floating_level, closed cover (<= 6.0 deg) and active ON cycle all hold at the end step but arms are not yet 3.0 cm clear or 1.0 s still; 0.50 when floating_level and closed cover hold with cycle OFF; 0.25 when floating_level holds with cover > 6.0 deg open; 0.00 otherwise. Real trial post-run checks, in order (objective numeric measurements): (1) Dry grippers & tip-angle check (from video + blotting): verify on trial video that neither gripper's +4 mm white pad-tip band descended to or below the engraved MAX waterline inside the open tank (and blot all four nitrile-cotted pads against a dry lint-free tissue — any visible wet spot scores 0), and confirm from video that rack tilt never exceeded 18 deg during transfer or release. (2) Active cycle, closed lid & arm-clearance check (before touching the bath): confirm the front red ON LED is illuminated with neither front button held down, check with an 11 mm go/no-go feeler gauge at the front lip that cover lift is <= 11 mm (<= 6.0 deg), and verify from video + a 30 mm gauge block that both grippers are >= 3.0 cm clear with the rack stationary (< 1.0 cm/s) over the final 1.0 s. (3) Floating freeboard & wall-clearance check: press OFF, gently lift the cover, and measure with the stepped ruler freeboard_gauge.stl that the dry foam top sits 16.1 +/- 6.0 mm above the water surface (within +/- 4.0 mm of the +8.4 cm tank rim), corner-to-corner foam height differs by <= 5.5 mm (<= 6.0 deg across 5.4 cm), and all four foam edges clear the stainless tank walls by >= 0.7 cm laterally (matching |dx| <= 2.0 cm, |dy| <= 3.6 cm inside the 9.6 x 15.6 cm tank).
reset_notes: Between trials (< 45 s): if the bath is running, press OFF; lift the smoked cover back against its 102 deg rear gravity stop; lift the rack by its dry upper foam rim, blot its underside and protruding tube exteriors dry with a lint-free wipe, verify total loaded mass is 22.0 +/- 0.5 g on a 0.1 g scale, and set it flat onto staging_cradle.stl at (25.0, +17.0); top up or wick bath water to the 14.0 mm below-rim MAX step of freeboard_gauge.stl (480 mL); verify all four nitrile finger cots are dry.
fidelity: Rigid bodies; bath water is not simulated as a continuum fluid. The 480 mL fill is shown as a non-colliding water plane at +7.0 cm above the bench mat, while vertical Archimedes support of the 22.0 g loaded rack (7.30 mL displaced by the eight 1.9 cm conical tube tips plus 3.86 mm foam draft = foam centre +7.61 cm above mat, 16.1 mm dry foam freeboard) is provided by an invisible low-friction hydrostatic support plane at +4.71 cm at the tube tips; lateral tank walls, the 8 bored foam wells, the 8 turned conical tubes, the over-centre gravity-hinged domed cover and the 900 N/m sprung ON/OFF switches resolve through convex-hull PhysX contact. Solid-state CD2800 timer electronics (ON click latches red cycle_led on; OFF click clears it), > 18 deg well-flooding and < 4 mm above-water gripper wetting are tracked by per-step rules.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (reaches left arm to the foam rack on the staging cradle and nudges its corner without lifting it; bath lid stays open); demo: 1.0 (seeds 0 and 1, 479 steps); scorer checks: rack_only 0.25, no_sonicate 0.50, no_release 0.75, tilt_flood 0.00
